## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcparsedasmoperand">MCParsedAsmOperand</a> - This abstract class represents a source-level assembly instruction operand.</p>


<p>It should be subclassed by target-specific code. This base class is used by target-independent clients and is the interface between parsing an asm instruction and recognizing it.</p>
